prompt: What is the exact value of $\tan 45^\circ$?

hints.text: At $45^\circ$ the sine and the cosine are the same number, $\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}$.
A number divided by itself is $1$, so $\tan 45^\circ = 1$.

explanation: The top and bottom are identical, so the quotient is $1$.

alternativeExplanations.title: From a right triangle
steps: A $45^\circ$-$45^\circ$-$90^\circ$ triangle has two equal legs.
Tangent is opposite over adjacent, and here those two legs are equal, so the ratio is $1$.
This is why a $45^\circ$ ramp rises exactly as much as it runs.
